title: Heavy rain floods roads, topples trees across Seoul

blocks.text: Heavy rain battered Seoul on Sunday, leaving roads flooded, trees uprooted and traffic disrupted across the city. Flooding forced the closure of the underpass beneath Jeungsan Bridge in Seodaemun-gu in both directions at 3:04 p.m., before traffic resumed at around 4:17 p.m., according to the Seoul Metropolitan Government’s traffic information system. Several expressway sections, including the Yangjae-Anseong stretch of the Gyeongbu Expressway, were also affected by heavy rainfall and strong winds. In Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu, a fallen tree reportedly blocked a road, disrupting vehicle and pedestrian traffic. READ: Extreme rain events in S.
